spec.rationale: Prospective calibration cohort ineligible: registration is after the expected publication window even though FY2026 TTM normalized owner earnings remain unresolvable from sec_companyfacts at the information cutoff (adapter returns ttm_period_inputs_missing on 2026-10-20). Types the owner-earnings leg of the operating_business_and_net_assets prose falsifier. The low-case owner_earnings_reinvestment_dcf proof locks owner_earnings at 13,288 USD millions (FY2025 operating cash flow tag on accession 0000858877-25-000111). Resolution uses normalized_owner_earnings_ttm_m_v2 (TTM operating cash flow minus absolute TTM capital expenditures via sec_companyfacts_ttm). If trailing-twelve-month normalized owner earnings at FY2026 year-end (2026-07-25) resolve below that low-case anchor, distributable owner cash has fallen below the low-case bridge and the bounded per-share range should compress toward the low case (31.89 USD per share vs 58.05 base). Incremental after-tax ROIC and reinvestment-rate legs remain judgment inputs without a resolvable SEC metric and are not typed here. Historical adapter replay on Q3 FY2025 (measurement end 2025-04-26) resolved 12,803 USD millions via sec_companyfacts_ttm. DOWNLOAD_MANIFEST lists FY2026 10-K (accession 0000858877-26-000132, filed 2026-09-02); companyfacts TTM inputs for the target period are still missing at cutoff, so the forecast remains ex ante on adapter observability, not on filing absence. Routed memory observation 06b22c8bf05e5160a342009a verified against manifest and adapter replay. Component fingerprint unchanged; this revision rebinds to input digest d1679cacf76599c4f888c341608307c8c8d1c757 without adapting thresholds or probability to post-cutoff evidence. A 34% fire probability weights interim cash softness against Cisco fiscal Q4 seasonality and historically sticky enterprise networking cash flow.
